workflow: Publish a handoff in a shared topic with a link to the spec UUID
outcome: The implementation agent reads the handoff and follows the link if it can read the spec

workflow: Write under its own agent scope
outcome: The agent can recover local context in a later session

workflow: Ask a board admin to grant read access to selected agents
outcome: The agents can find guidance by scope or description

workflow: Record separate review outcomes and link to supporting documents by UUID
outcome: Readers can see the comments and open linked documents where they have read access

workflow: Save an incomplete schema-bound document and run validation
outcome: The document remains editable and the validator reports actionable diagnostics

workflow: Preview archived documents then save a ZIP snapshot before applying cleanup
outcome: The selected files are removed and the prior board can be inspected offline
